column1: # Checklist items of the AutoCAD parity benchmark (see docs/BENCHMARK.md).
# axis <TAB> id <TAB> credit (0..1) <TAB> what AutoCAD offers <TAB> evidence <TAB> what is missing
# Credit is a self-assessment; every credit above 0 must point at code or tests (path-or-glob::regex, several separated by " ; ")
# and `score.py --check` fails when a pointer no longer matches.  Credit 0 items list a known gap and need no evidence.

column4: Circles, arcs, ellipses and elliptical arcs
Polylines with arc segments, closed shapes, join and edit
Splines (fit points, control vertices, weights, knots)
column6: fit-point splines only: no control vertices, weights or knots

column4: Single-line text and multiline text with width
column6: MTEXT supports \P paragraphs only: no inline bold, colour, stacking or columns

column4: Linear, aligned, angular, radius, diameter, ordinate, arc length, jogged, baseline and continued dimensions
Dimensions that follow the geometry they measure
column6: dimensions keep their own definition points

column4: Tables with merged cells, styles and cell text
Pattern, solid and gradient hatches with islands
Regions, wipeouts, revision clouds, donuts, 2D solids and traces
Block references with attributes, nesting, scale and rotation

column6: references are taken from open drawings; no reload from a file path

column4: Raster images with clip, brightness / contrast / fade, frame
3D polylines, 3D lines and Z coordinates on every object
column6: entities are 2D; only solids have a third dimension

column4: Layouts and viewports as drawing objects
A lossless native file with the whole drawing
Write DXF that AutoCAD-class readers accept

column6: only generated R2000+ files are in the corpus
not implemented: the format is proprietary

column4: Text encodings: code pages, UTF-8, \U+ and %% codes
Paper space layouts, viewports and sheet sizes in DXF
Newer entities in DXF: multileader, mline, wipeout, images, gradients, attributes
column6: some are read as simpler geometry (MLINE as polylines, multileaders as leader and text)

SAT, STEP, IGES, FBX, 3DS and other exchange formats
